reports.title: ADI Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Updates Full-Year Outlook

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: The Company is lowering its full-year 2026 outlook to reflect third-quarter performance and further weakness in Exclusive
Brands in October. The revised outlook assumes these demand and mix pressures persist through the remainder of the year.

($ in millions) | Nine Months Ended (1) | Q4 2026 | Full Year 2026
Net revenue | $3,798 | $1,112 - 1,132 | $4,910 - $4,930
Non-GAAP Adjusted Standalone EBITDA (Estimate) | $202 | $28 - $38 | $230 - $240
(1) Nine Months Ended 2026 represents results for the nine months ended October 3, 2026, as presented below.
